name: logo-tiger
title: Logo Tiger / Logo Go
summary: Logo Tiger and Logo Go on SQL Server. Firm (card) tables are LG_FFF_TABLE and period (transaction) tables LG_FFF_PP_TABLE, where FFF is the three-digit firm number and PP the two-digit period (LG_001_CLCARD, LG_001_01_INVOICE). Summary views are LV_FFF_PP_… . Every table's key is LOGICALREF; foreign keys are the *REF columns pointing at it.
rules: Always filter CANCELLED = 0 on transaction tables.
Item names are ITEMS.NAME; account names are CLCARD.DEFINITION_ (with the trailing underscore).
On STLINE use LINETYPE = 0 for goods lines (others are promotions, discounts, surcharges, services).
INVOICE.TRCODE: 1 purchase, 4 service received, 7 retail sale, 8 wholesale sale, 9 service given (likely). Sales invoices are TRCODE IN (7, 8).
Ledger balances (CLFLINE) are per period: a balance across years needs a UNION over each LG_FFF_PP_CLFLINE table, or must start from the period's opening entries.
Find the firm and period numbers first: SELECT name FROM sys.tables WHERE name LIKE 'LG[_]%[_]CLCARD' (firms) and LIKE 'LG[_]%[_]%[_]INVOICE' (periods).

tables.name: LG_{FIRM}_CLCARD
tables.title: Current account card (cari kart): customers and vendors

tables.name: LG_{FIRM}_ITEMS
tables.title: Item card (malzeme kartı)
columns: 1 trade goods, 10 raw material, 11 semi-finished, 12 finished good, 13 consumable, 4 fixed asset

tables.name: LG_{FIRM}_{PERIOD}_STLINE
tables.title: Stock lines (stok hareketi) — also the lines of invoices and dispatches

tables.name: LG_{FIRM}_{PERIOD}_STFICHE
tables.title: Stock slips and dispatch notes (irsaliye / stok fişi)

tables.name: LV_{FIRM}_{PERIOD}_STINVTOT
tables.title: Stock totals per item and warehouse (view)
tables.notes: Filter INVENNO = -1 for the all-warehouse total.

queries.title: Stock on hand for one item, all warehouses
queries.sql: SELECT I.CODE, I.NAME, SUM(T.ONHAND) AS Qty FROM LV_001_01_STINVTOT T JOIN LG_001_ITEMS I ON T.STOCKREF = I.LOGICALREF WHERE T.INVENNO = -1 AND I.CODE = 'ITEM-CODE' GROUP BY I.CODE, I.NAME

queries.title: Sales invoices, last 30 days
queries.sql: SELECT F.FICHENO, F.DATE_, C.DEFINITION_, F.NETTOTAL FROM LG_001_01_INVOICE F JOIN LG_001_CLCARD C ON F.CLIENTREF = C.LOGICALREF WHERE F.TRCODE IN (7, 8) AND F.CANCELLED = 0 AND F.DATE_ >= DATEADD(day, -30, GETDATE())

queries.title: Open balance of one account in the current period
queries.sql: SELECT C.CODE, C.DEFINITION_, SUM(CASE WHEN L.SIGN = 0 THEN L.AMOUNT ELSE -L.AMOUNT END) AS Balance FROM LG_001_01_CLFLINE L JOIN LG_001_CLCARD C ON L.CLIENTREF = C.LOGICALREF WHERE L.CANCELLED = 0 AND C.CODE = 'ACCOUNT-CODE' GROUP BY C.CODE, C.DEFINITION_
